name: Marta Babicz
quote: Over the past few months, I've been on a coaching journey with Jasmine, and it was such a creative and positively surprising experience for me. Throughout the process, I learned a lot about myself and engaged in many practices that were both bold and inspiring. What amazed me most was how effortlessly Jasmine adapted to all my very personal approaches and ideas and everything resonated with me so well. Thanks to her thoughtful guidance, I now feel stronger as a leader and, in general, more confident and at the same time calmer, with many tools and reflections that will stay with me for a long time. I can wholeheartedly recommend Jasmine from the bottom of my heart, working with her has been truly transformative. Thank you, Jasmine!
